points.title: 成长岁月
points.description: 叶利钦出生于斯维尔德洛夫斯克州布特卡村的一个农民家庭。他在当地完成基础教育后，于1955年毕业于乌拉尔工学院建筑系。这段时期塑造了他坚韧不拔的性格和对普通民众生活的深刻理解。他积极参与共青团工作，展现出领导才能，为日后进入政坛奠定了基础。在斯维尔德洛夫斯克的生活经历使他对苏联体制有了初步认识，也为他后来对体制的批判埋下了种子。
points.descriptionEn: Boris Yeltsin was born in the village of Butka in Sverdlovsk Oblast to a peasant family. After completing his basic education, he graduated from the Ural Polytechnic Institute's construction department in 1955. This period shaped his resilient character and deep understanding of ordinary people's lives. He actively participated in Komsomol work, demonstrating leadership qualities that laid the foundation for his future political career. His experiences in Sverdlovsk gave him initial insights into the Soviet system, planting seeds for his later criticisms of the establishment.

points.title: 地方崛起
points.description: 叶利钦从建筑工程师起步，逐渐进入政坛。他担任过斯维尔德洛夫斯克州建筑局局长、州委书记等职。在此期间，他展现了高效的管理能力和改革倾向。1981年，他成为苏共中央候补委员，1985年调任莫斯科，担任苏共莫斯科市委第一书记。在斯维尔德洛夫斯克的经历使他积累了丰富的行政管理经验，同时也让他对苏联体制的弊端有了更深刻的认识，为他后来的改革思想奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Starting as a construction engineer, Yeltsin gradually entered politics. He served as director of the Sverdlovsk Construction Department and later as First Secretary of the Sverdlovsk Regional Party Committee. During this time, he demonstrated effective administrative skills and reformist tendencies. In 1981, he became a candidate member of the CPSU Central Committee, and in 1985 was transferred to Moscow as First Secretary of the Moscow City Party Committee. His experiences in Sverdlovsk provided him with rich administrative experience and deeper insights into the flaws of the Soviet system, laying the foundation for his later reformist ideas.

points.title: 莫斯科改革
points.description: 叶利钦被戈尔巴乔夫调至莫斯科，担任苏共莫斯科市委第一书记。他在此大力推行改革，打击腐败，提高住房建设效率，赢得了民众支持。然而，他的激进改革也引起了党内保守派的反对。1987年在苏共中央全会上，他公开批评戈尔巴乔夫的改革步伐过慢，结果被解除莫斯科市委第一书记职务。这一挫折使叶利钦转向反对派立场，成为苏联体制内的改革派批评者，为他日后成为民主派领袖奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Yeltsin was transferred to Moscow by Gorbachev to serve as First Secretary of the Moscow City Party Committee. He vigorously promoted reforms, fighting corruption and improving housing construction efficiency, gaining popular support. However, his radical reforms also drew opposition from conservative party members. At the 1987 CPSU Central Committee plenum, he publicly criticized Gorbachev for the slow pace of reforms, resulting in his removal as First Secretary of the Moscow City Party Committee. This setback pushed Yeltsin toward the opposition, making him a critic of the Soviet system from within and laying the foundation for his future role as a democratic leader.

points.title: 反对派领袖
points.description: 被解除职务后，叶利钦成为苏联体制内的主要反对派。1989年，他当选为苏联人民代表，并在1990年当选为俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国最高苏维埃主席。他积极推动俄罗斯主权宣言，主张扩大共和国权力。1991年6月，他当选为俄罗斯联邦首任总统，成为苏联解体过程中的关键人物。在莫斯科的这段时期，叶利钦从体制内改革者转变为民主派领袖，为苏联的和平解体和俄罗斯联邦的建立奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After being removed from his position, Yeltsin became the main opposition figure within the Soviet system. In 1989, he was elected as a People's Deputy of the USSR, and in 1990 as Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. He actively promoted the Russian sovereignty declaration, advocating for expanded republican powers. In June 1991, he was elected as the first President of the Russian Federation, becoming a key figure in the process of the Soviet Union's dissolution. During this period in Moscow, Yeltsin transformed from an insider reformer to a democratic leader, laying the foundation for the peaceful dissolution of the USSR and the establishment of the Russian Federation.

points.title: 总统任期
points.description: 作为俄罗斯首任总统，叶利钦经历了苏联解体、俄罗斯联邦建立、经济休克疗法、1993年宪法危机、第一次车臣战争等重大事件。他推动了一系列激进改革，包括私有化和市场经济转型，但也导致了严重的经济衰退和社会动荡。1993年，他与议会发生冲突，下令炮轰白宫，确立了总统制。1996年连任后，他任命年轻的经济学家普京为总理，为权力交接做准备。在莫斯科的总统任期，叶利钦塑造了现代俄罗斯的政治格局，但也留下了经济衰退、寡头政治和腐败等严重问题。
points.descriptionEn: As Russia's first president, Yeltsin oversaw the dissolution of the USSR, the establishment of the Russian Federation, economic shock therapy, the 1993 constitutional crisis, and the First Chechen War. He pushed through radical reforms including privatization and market economy transformation, but these led to severe economic recession and social turmoil. In 1993, he clashed with parliament and ordered the shelling of the White House, establishing a presidential system. After re-election in 1996, he appointed the young economist Putin as prime minister, preparing for a power transition. His presidential years in Moscow shaped modern Russia's political landscape but also left serious problems including economic recession, oligarchy, and corruption.

points.title: 退休生活
points.description: 1999年12月31日，叶利钦突然宣布辞职，将权力移交给普京。退休后，他很少公开露面，但仍然受到公众关注。他在莫斯科郊外的住宅中撰写回忆录，反思自己的政治生涯。2007年4月23日，叶利钦因心脏衰竭去世，享年76岁。他的葬礼以国葬形式举行，普京等国家领导人出席。叶利钦的退休生活相对低调，但他作为苏联解体和俄罗斯转型关键人物的历史地位已经确立，他的政治遗产对俄罗斯的发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: On December 31, 1999, Yeltsin unexpectedly resigned, transferring power to Putin. After retirement, he rarely appeared in public but remained a figure of public attention. He wrote his memoirs in his residence outside Moscow, reflecting on his political career. On April 23, 2007, Yeltsin died of heart failure at the age of 76. His funeral was held as a state funeral, attended by national leaders including Putin. Yeltsin's retirement years were relatively low-profile, but his historical status as a key figure in the dissolution of the USSR and Russia's transformation was firmly established, and his political legacy has had a profound impact on Russia's development.

appraisal.zh: 叶利钦通常被视为苏联解体的关键推动者与俄罗斯转型时代的象征，他在1991年八一九政变中站到坦克前、在1993年宪法危机中维护总统权威，被看作塑造俄罗斯发展轨迹的决断时刻，尽管代价沉重。学界主流认为他的统治是俄罗斯从共产主义转向民主的必要而痛苦的阶段，遗产中既有民主制度的建立，也有经济衰退与寡头政治的阴影。也有研究者指出，休克疗法使多数人陷入贫困、少数人借私有化暴富，1993年炮轰白宫更被视作对民主的背叛，其任人唯亲与缺乏远见为后来的威权统治铺了路。
appraisal.en: Yeltsin is generally seen as a key driver of the Soviet Union's dissolution and a symbol of Russia's transitional era, his stand before the tanks during the 1991 August Coup and his defense of presidential authority in the 1993 constitutional crisis regarded as decisive moments that shaped Russia's trajectory, though at heavy cost. Mainstream scholarship treats his rule as a necessary but painful phase in the shift from communism toward democracy, a legacy combining the building of democratic institutions with economic recession and oligarchy. Yet other researchers note that shock therapy impoverished most while a few grew rich through privatization, and that the 1993 shelling of the White House was a betrayal of democracy, with cronyism and a lack of vision paving the way for later authoritarian rule.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为叶利钦是俄罗斯民主化的先驱，勇敢地挑战了苏联体制，为俄罗斯带来了自由和民主。他结束了冷战，使俄罗斯走上了民主道路，尽管过程艰难。叶利钦的勇气和决断力，特别是在1991年八一九政变中站在坦克前保卫白宫，以及在1993年宪法危机中维护总统权威，被视为俄罗斯民主制度建立的关键时刻。支持者认为他为俄罗斯的未来奠定了基础，尽管付出了巨大代价。
supporter.en: Supporters view Yeltsin as a pioneer of Russian democracy, who bravely challenged the Soviet system and brought freedom and democracy to Russia. He ended the Cold War and set Russia on a democratic path, albeit a difficult one. Yeltsin's courage and decisiveness, particularly in standing before tanks to defend the White House during the 1991 August Coup and maintaining presidential authority during the 1993 constitutional crisis, are seen as pivotal moments in establishing Russia's democratic system. Supporters believe he laid the foundation for Russia's future, despite the heavy price paid.

critic.zh: 批评者指责叶利钦的改革导致了经济崩溃、社会动荡和寡头政治的形成。他的休克疗法经济政策使大多数俄罗斯人陷入贫困，而少数人通过私有化积累了巨额财富。1993年炮轰白宫的事件被视为对民主的背叛，建立了超级总统制。批评者认为叶利钦的领导缺乏连贯性和远见，任人唯亲，腐败横行，为普京的威权统治铺平了道路。他的政治遗产被普遍认为是失败的，给俄罗斯留下了深刻的社会和经济问题。
critic.en: Critics accuse Yeltsin's reforms of leading to economic collapse, social turmoil, and the rise of oligarchy. His shock therapy economic policies plunged most Russians into poverty while a few accumulated vast wealth through privatization. The 1993 shelling of the White House is seen as a betrayal of democracy, establishing a super-presidential system. Critics argue that Yeltsin's leadership lacked coherence and vision, was marked by cronyism and corruption, and paved the way for Putin's authoritarian rule. His political legacy is widely regarded as a failure, leaving Russia with deep social and economic problems.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，叶利钦是一位复杂的历史人物，既是苏联解体的关键推动者，也是俄罗斯转型时期的象征。他在历史关键时刻的决断力改变了俄罗斯的发展轨迹，但同时也带来了巨大的社会成本。在流行文化中，叶利钦常被描绘为一个矛盾的形象：既有民主改革者的勇气，又有政治家的不成熟和反复无常。历史学界普遍认为，叶利钦的统治是俄罗斯从共产主义向民主过渡的必要但痛苦的阶段，他的遗产既有民主制度的建立，也有经济衰退和寡头政治的阴影。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Yeltsin was a complex figure who was both a key driver of the Soviet Union's dissolution and a symbol of Russia's transitional period. His decisive actions at critical historical moments changed Russia's trajectory, but also came with enormous social costs. In popular culture, Yeltsin is often depicted as a contradictory figure: possessing the courage of a democratic reformer yet also the immaturity and inconsistency of a politician. Historiography generally views Yeltsin's rule as a necessary but painful phase in Russia's transition from communism to democracy, with a legacy that includes both the establishment of democratic institutions and the shadows of economic recession and oligarchy.

self.zh: 我将权力交给更年轻、更有活力、更有俄罗斯未来的人。
self.en: I am handing over power to a younger, stronger, and more vigorous person who will bring Russia into the future.
